fusions.name: Shove Off the Ledge
fusions.desc: A butting blow that deals 18 rock damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Ledge Jab
fusions.desc: A reaching jab from sure footing at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 7% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 35%).

fusions.name: Unshiftable Footing
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Last Foothold
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
